A neglectful West Virginia wife is accused of leaving her frail, ailing husband on the toilet for 19 hours, which ultimately led to his death about a week later, according to cops and reports.

Margaret Rog, 75, was arrested Tuesday after she left her 76-year-old husband on the can overnight, resulting in serious health conditions that contributed to his death, the Monongalia County Sheriff’s Office said, WDTV reported.

After her husband went to the bathroom around 3 p.m. on Aug. 20, Rog was unable to help him off the toilet. Instead of calling for help, she left him unattended and unresponsive for 19 hours without food, water or his prescribed medications, according to the sheriff.
